title: A durable WO chat is only allocated through the HMAC-signed door; the browser cannot pick a new ID
steps: Call chat allocation with and without a signature, with a wrong role/folder/preset; retry with a fresh nonce; send a new ID over browser RPC.
Use an ID granted to another seat; revoke while a native RPC is pending; call an old/missing web allocator.
expect: Only the owner of exactly one site folder is allocated; a retry keeps the same ID and sends no prompt; a new browser ID gets 403 and no session/create reaches upstream.
A grant/revoke conflict gives no new grant and no successful token/cookie.
The web never falls back to a random chat or raw browser RPC when the signed allocator fails or is too old.
Before the prompt there must be a baseline of the same seat holding exactly the chat and folder; missing, closed or wrong-folder means no prompt.
fence: HMAC+nonce, owner/site scope, native identity, exclusive grant and a credential-version re-check after the RPC; the core browser fence is unchanged.

tests: signed site allocation holds one identity across retries; browser-chosen IDs remain refused
a site allocation cannot grant another account
revocation while native site allocation is waiting prevents a grant and token
site allocation accepts only one signed owner folder and the server-held WO identity
a durable site session uses the signed allocation twice with one identity and fresh nonces
an unavailable or older signed site allocator never falls back to a random browser chat
a server-held chat must appear in the same seat baseline and exact site folder
closed and missing baselines fail closed with a bounded wait
prompt waits for the filtered baseline and never sends for a foreign folder
